title: Root Mealy Bug on Black Pepper

Header: Root Mealy Bug on Black Pepper
Planococcus cittri (Risso) Sinhala – Piti makuna; Tamil – Milaku ven mooddu poochchi

Prevention: Keep 2 feet weed free land surrounding the pepper vines
Slash the alternate hosts and weeds in rest of the field
Maintain the vigour of pepper vine by application of recommended fertilizer
Control ants as much as possible (by wood ash)
Monitoring: Observe mature plants regularly in the field for yellowing of vines and ants around the vines
Direct Control: Remove and destroy (burn) higly infested vines
Rate of dilution – 5 ml / 10 lit. of water.
Rate of dilution – 10g / 10 lit. of water.
Rate of dilution – 1.5g / 10 lit. of water.
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying pesticides
U - Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use
Use against the pest and ants.
Toxic to aquatic organisms, bees, certain birds and reptiles.
Toxic to predatory mites, flower bugs, parasitoids, lady bird beetles and moderately toxic to lacewings.
